mentions.name: Wanes
mentions.description: An Apple Health logging interface for tracking how long symptoms last. It starts a Live Activity for one or more symptoms using widgets, Control Center or Siri, lets you change the severity rating while it runs, and can be stopped from anywhere on the phone (Home Screen, Lock Screen, Dynamic Island, Siri).
mentions.problem: Apple Health's built-in symptom data entry is pretty limited for someone who gets frequent headaches and wants to track how long symptoms last.
mentions.source_excerpt: Wanes[2], an Apple Health logging interface for tracking how long symptoms last. I tend to have headaches quite often and the way Apple lets you enter that data is pretty limited, so I created an app which starts a Live Activity for one or more symptoms using widgets, Control Center or Siri. You can change the severity rating while it runs and stop it from wherever you are on your phone (Home Screen, Lock Screen, Dynamic Island, Siri).
mentions.author: josters
